run_benchmark_internal: run a benchmark against an internal SGLang server with configurable batch sizes, input/output lengths, and cache hit rates
launch_server_process: launch an SGLang HTTP server in a subprocess and wait for it to become ready
run_one_case: run a single benchmark case with specified batch size, input length, output length, and dataset
calculate_cache_hit_rate: calculate cache hit rate from before and after Prometheus metrics snapshots
get_report_summary: generate a tabulated benchmark report with throughput, latency, and cost metrics
